items.title: MERED向Dutco授予Riviera Residences一期建筑总包合同
items.title_en: MERED appoints Dutco as main contractor for Riviera Residences Phase 1
items.summary: MERED于11月12日确认，Dutco Construction获任阿布扎比Al Reem Island的Riviera Residences一期总承包商，负责主体施工、室内装修及景观工程。工程计划工期33个月，目标2029年第三季度完成；前期工程由NSCC International完成。合同金额未公布。
items.summary_en: On 12 November, MERED appointed Dutco Construction as main contractor for Phase 1 of Riviera Residences on Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi. Scope covers main construction, interior fit-out and landscaping under a 33-month programme, targeting completion in Q3 2029; enabling works were delivered by NSCC International. Contract value was not disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 总承包商已明确，适合GCI直接寻找施工劳务和建筑供应链机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: With the main contractor identified, the project offers a practical lead for workforce and construction suppliers.
items.gci_opportunity: 联系Dutco及分包体系，跟进建筑劳务、建材、机电和装修供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Engage Dutco and its subcontractors for workforce, materials, MEP and fit-out supply.

items.title: Ardee公布拉斯海马Al Marjan Island大型综合开发计划
items.title_en: Ardee unveils Ardee Downtown within AED15bn-plus Al Marjan Island portfolio
items.sector: 住宅酒店及商业综合开发
items.summary: Ardee于11月10日发布Ardee Downtown，作为其在拉斯海马Al Marjan Island的大型住宅、酒店、商业与休闲开发组合一部分。整体组合预计总开发价值超过150亿迪拉姆，涉及Ardee Downtown与Ardee Waterfront，并非单个Downtown项目的独立施工合同价值。Downtown计划自2030年起分期交付。
items.summary_en: On 10 November, Ardee unveiled Ardee Downtown, part of its Al Marjan Island residential, hospitality, retail and leisure portfolio in Ras Al Khaimah. The portfolio has gross development value exceeding AED15 billion across Ardee Downtown and Ardee Waterfront; this is not a single construction contract for Downtown. Phased delivery of Downtown is planned from 2030.
items.why_it_matters: 大型长期开发可产生酒店、住宅和商业设施供应需求，但目前是规划发布。
items.why_it_matters_en: The long-term masterplan could create residential, hospitality and retail supply opportunities, though it remains at the planning stage.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进开发商及未来总包、家具、精装、建材和劳务机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor developer, future contractor, furniture, fit-out, materials and workforce opportunities.

items.title: Azizi Developments扩张14.3万平方米建筑制造能力
items.title_en: Azizi Developments expands in-house manufacturing footprint across 143,000 sqm
items.summary: Azizi Developments于11月11日公布迪拜与沙迦的制造体系扩张，涉及约14.3万平方米主要制造场地，包括沙迦Sajaa的约11.4万平方米预制构件工厂及约2.9万平方米Freesia MEP生产设施，并有迪拜混凝土和钢筋加工配套。不是新公开采购招标。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, Azizi Developments announced expansion of its in-house manufacturing network across Dubai and Sharjah, including an approximately 114,000 sqm precast facility in Sajaa and a 29,000 sqm Freesia MEP manufacturing shed, plus ready-mix and steel processing operations in Dubai. This is a manufacturing rollout, not an open public tender.
items.why_it_matters: 制造业扩张与建筑供应链、生产设备和技术工人需求直接相关。
items.why_it_matters_en: The expansion may generate demand for manufacturing systems, construction materials and skilled workers.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注预制构件机械、机电制造设备、物流、原材料及技术劳工。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track precast machinery, MEP production equipment, logistics, raw materials and skilled labour.

items.title: 据MEED报道中国杰瑞集团获PDO Al-Ghubar油田设施工程合同
items.title_en: MEED reports Jereh Group won PDO Al-Ghubar oilfield facility contract
items.summary: MEED于11月12日报道，阿曼石油开发公司PDO在Qarn Alam的Al-Ghubar油田油气重力泄油（GOGD）设施主合同由中国Jereh Group获得，设施涉及含硫油气及水处理和生产出口连接。授标依据业内消息，尚未核实PDO或杰瑞正式公告；合同金额未公布。
items.summary_en: On 12 November, MEED reported, citing industry sources, that China's Jereh Group had won the principal contract for PDO's Al-Ghubar gas-oil gravity drainage facility at Qarn Alam, encompassing sour oil, gas and water handling and export connections. An official PDO or Jereh award statement was not independently verified; contract value remains undisclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 若消息获确认，将为中国承包商供应链带来工程与物资合作机会；授标状态仍需业主确认。
items.why_it_matters_en: If confirmed, the award may create Chinese contractor supply opportunities; owner verification is outstanding.
items.gci_opportunity: 优先核实杰瑞及PDO授标，随后接洽工业管道、设备和专业施工供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: First verify with Jereh or PDO, then explore industrial piping, equipment and specialist construction supply.
items.stage: 行业报道已授标／待业主确认

items.title: 阿曼Al Wusta签署逾5100万里亚尔南美白对虾养殖协议
items.title_en: Oman signs shrimp farming investment agreement exceeding RO51 million in Al Wusta
items.summary: 阿曼农业、渔业和水资源部于11月11日与Mukka Proteins签署Mahout地区白对虾商业养殖投资协议，投资金额超过5100万阿曼里亚尔，采用循环水养殖系统RAS，目标年产约3万吨。项目不是已授工程总包合同。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, Oman's Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources signed an investment agreement with Mukka Proteins for commercial whiteleg shrimp farming in Mahout, Al Wusta, with planned investment exceeding RO51 million. The recirculating aquaculture system is designed to support annual output of roughly 30,000 tonnes. No EPC construction award was announced.
items.why_it_matters: 食品和养殖产业可能形成水处理、冷链、包装及设施建设需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: The aquaculture investment may generate water treatment, cold-chain, packaging and facility development demand.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注RAS设备、冷库、食品加工、包装及工业设施施工合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor RAS systems, cold storage, processing, packaging and industrial construction partnerships.

items.title: 阿曼与美国企业拟在杜库姆建立Space Coast Oman航天产业园
items.title_en: US–Oman partners propose Space Coast Oman aerospace industrial hub in Duqm
items.sector: 航天工业园与基础设施
items.summary: 阿曼NASCOM与美国Karman Line于11月13日宣布合作备忘录，拟在杜库姆Etlaq航天发射场周边打造Space Coast Oman航天产业及商业综合园区，涵盖卫星相关制造、物流、工业设施和配套服务。双方目标于2026年12月31日前完成正式协议，现阶段没有EPC授标或已确定投资金额。
items.summary_en: On 13 November, Oman's NASCOM and US-based Karman Line announced an MoU for Space Coast Oman, a proposed aerospace industrial and commercial hub around Etlaq Spaceport in Duqm, potentially covering satellite manufacturing, logistics, industrial facilities and support services. Definitive agreements are targeted by 31 December 2026; no EPC award or committed value has been disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 航天产业链布局具有长期园区与设施需求，但目前仍处初步合作阶段。
items.why_it_matters_en: The proposed space economy cluster offers long-term infrastructure potential but remains at an early partnership stage.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注园区厂房、电力、物流、仓储及产业配套企业合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track industrial facilities, power, logistics, warehousing and specialist support partnerships.
items.stage: 合作备忘录／正式协议待签

items.title: 巴林签署Busaiteen跨海大桥第四阶段建设合同
items.title_en: Bahrain signs construction contracts for phase four of Busaiteen Bridge
items.summary: 巴林于11月12日签署连接麦纳麦与穆哈拉格的Busaiteen大桥第四阶段施工合同，据行业报道承建联合体为NASS与Nasser Hazza Al Subaie。项目估算成本约6500万巴林第纳尔，非已单独核实的中标合同价格。该项目接受沙特发展基金资助；官方确认第四阶段签约。
items.summary_en: On 12 November, Bahrain signed contracts to implement phase four of the Busaiteen Bridge connecting Manama and Muharraq. Industry reports identify a consortium of NASS and Nasser Hazza Al Subaie. The estimated project cost is about BD65 million, not a separately confirmed winning contract price. The Saudi Fund for Development supports the project, and its official release confirms the contract signing.
items.why_it_matters: 大型桥梁主合同已签，潜在机会主要位于材料和工程分包供应链。
items.why_it_matters_en: With construction contracts signed, practical opportunities lie in materials and subcontract supply chains.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注桥梁钢结构、混凝土、机械设备、道路配套和施工服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor structural steel, concrete, heavy equipment, road systems and construction services.
items.source_name: Saudi Press Agency / GCC Tender News

items.title: Dubai South与Cheval Collection合作开发193套酒店式公寓和品牌住宅
items.title_en: Dubai South and Cheval Collection partner on 193-unit Cheval South Bay
items.sector: 酒店式公寓与品牌住宅
items.summary: Dubai South与Cheval Collection于11月11日签署Cheval South Bay合作协议，拟在South Bay水岸社区开发193套高端住宿单元，包括98套酒店式公寓和95套品牌住宅，预计2030年投入运营。当前不是建筑总包授标公告。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, Dubai South and Cheval Collection signed an agreement for Cheval South Bay in the South Bay waterfront community, comprising 193 units: 98 serviced hotel apartments and 95 branded residences, scheduled to open in 2030. No construction main-contract award was announced.
items.why_it_matters: 品牌公寓和酒店经营可能形成家具、装修及运营物资的后续需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Branded residences and serviced hospitality could generate furniture, fit-out and operating supplies demand.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注酒店家具、厨房设备、装饰材料、物业设施和运营耗材。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor hotel furniture, kitchens, decorative materials, facilities and operating supplies.
